pedido.description: Top-down overworld map for a 16-bit SNES JRPG, portrait format. A whole tropical island fills the lower two thirds of the image, surrounded by deep blue ocean on the left, right and bottom, with sandy beaches. On the island: a dense pine forest and green meadows in the south-west, a blue lake with reeds in the east, orange desert badlands with cactus and a big volcano with glowing lava in the north. A pale dirt road with round stopping points links the south beach, the forest, the lake and the volcano and ends at a small wooden pier on the north shore. The top third of the image is open sea leading to a mysterious unexplored land completely hidden under a thick bank of white clouds and fog. Bright cheerful colors, clean detailed pixel art, no text, no letters, no characters, no interface.
